title: Save eight H1 queries with a verified deferred-K correction (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Save **eight paid H1 calls per direction** in the named balanced-J source-query interface, under the retained native ABI. Remove the eight old-h queries and their copied-query lifetimes, retain the actual native/alias/scalar segments, pay all 120 queries on the current returned source bank, and apply `K -= 3 Z_s E_p + 13 E_h` before destination encoding. The ordered main endpoint is unchanged: `(Du-Rv, JRv)`. E remains unchanged at every correction primitive; the existing owned c0 is cleared before use and returned zero.

The comparison is original fused T followed by the **same full current-source Q120 layer**. H1 changes2321→2313, with all other paid ranks and 392 independent helper jobs unchanged:

```
Pnew={1:2313,2:412,3:510,4:127,5:40}.
```

This is a validated local recursive saving with an explicit ordinary bill. It supplies no new canonical main targets, thin-query reuse, complete caller or funded κ. The 392 helper transforms are positive in both directions; they are not asserted to compose as inverses.

`ECONOMICS.md` supplies the accompanying scoped limit. Even granting120 D8 outputs,120 R9 outputs and all 392 helpers with remaining work free, the displayed standalone FULL120 profile has negative target-minus-paid moment for every `0<C<1`. At `C=.00330007`, a change consisting **only** of additional H1 deletions/reuses needs at least 28 further actual paid occurrences removed, with all targets and other calls fixed. The eight calls saved here are already absent. This is necessary only, and does not govern a different caller or changed paid/target profile.

## Task and overlap

Explicit donor assignment refines priority-revision 7 `independent-moment` to a source-bound occurrence overlay; `TASK.json` declares `scope_status: changed` and its connection to the cost bottleneck. Canonical base is `1a3ced60b2f7a46bc70280a04f2eeb8ca027c700`, selected conditional κ `.003027288235` under the same five assumptions.

The peer retains original fused-T derivation/implementation and the separate complete-caller search. This complementary overlay and unchanged dependency vendoring have explicit coordination clearance. The preserved sources are labelled LOCAL generated evidence; filenames containing PUBLIC are not a claim of public Git ancestry. Public predecessors include native #5402 (`3348fccea855082786d5f0fc5558b73d4974e745`), actual inverse #5411 (`123ffa6aa7c1866ac60c67739841f71d95b3edf7`) and consumer #5419 (`d94f60b3b603782fce40f1911b3b094847d0f45a`). #5418/#5420 supply separate scoped economic support.

The all-author PR feed was refreshed through06:04UTC, including #5422's old-#4610 scalar-pair negative; that scope does not cover this changed interface. Newest handoffs in #1166 were also read before submission, including the unreplied Rohan source request and the current replay-maintenance notices. These are bounded checks, not exhaustive novelty certification or ownership of another contributor's decoder.

The publication also reuses the exact #5420 CI-navigation repair because canonical main still pointed its current CI section at the historical 4610 command. The sole extra file is `docs/ci-verification.md`; no scientific package or test is changed by that successor.

## Validation

The emitted packet is `9f4578a8d85a16f1d19b4fe759a2d5aa17c9d84d4028f48940e85c9843f3ce8e`. Independent checker v2 is `dae704de19122deed696cfcdc6fb1479faac66cd42aa4d87d9c0285a30d38600`. It interprets the new correction on129 independent inputs, preserves all 120 source rows at every primitive, joins the retained main 240+9owned contract, checks both main inverse products, and checks the ordered algebraic MAIN raw inverse transpose with `J^T` retained. A literal full helper/owned physical dual remains open.

The current query is bare positive C1 on physical central axis0, uniquely fixed by `Q=R D^-1` in the actual phase-bound native output equations. An analytical counterexample from an actual mode word rejects the proposed K-conjugated route; full-R intertwining does not imply separate q or D commutation. The inverse uses120 positive central calls plus 120 ordinary central translations. Twelve controls reject wrong versions/order, omitted calls/correction, extra query phase, wrong source phase/stage, source writes and missing cleanup.

The external bill per direction is 1952 unit/half ADDs,136 COPY,24 SWAP,272 CLEAR,272 zero-retags and 120 paid Q calls, plus one unchanged native provider. Monomial maps are 1168 forward and 1288 inverse, including 800 inherited aliases. Native internal work remains inherited and charged. No ordinary instruction is converted into a recursive-rank credit.

The sole peer's first independent normal/O pair passed in0.704941994/0.807483174 seconds, sampled peaks54,849,536/52,019,200 bytes. Their full 15,698-byte results match, SHA256 `15bdc61d48d082224865f212ea8471d3f323b511bf1af1afd18c16895b0a5db9`, with zero JSON exclusions. All 38 pre/post byte/mode records stayed unchanged (34 at 0664, four at 0444); these two runs were not a filesystem-readonly test.

After the 74-file package freeze, three further serial guarded requests passed: registered normal/O pair **2.923508826s,103,223,296B**, portable normal **1.207998975s,71,475,200B**, portable optimized **1.410404486s,80,482,304B**. Portable files were0444/directories0555, with empty PATH, no Git metadata inside the copy and explicit Git-discovery ceiling; ancestor Git metadata was preserved and discovery under the ceiling returned exit128. The official canonical signed-invoice comparator separately ran once: `uniformly_better`, `delta_paid={"1":-8}`, `delta_targets={}`, strict negative new-minus-old power cost for `0<t<1`, using only the 392 unchanged actual helper credits and no hypothetical main reward. Runtime 0.101276681s; this integer concave-order screen validates the declared relative invoice, not absolute profitability or source admission. The source tool is canonical `scripts/compare_recursive_invoices.py`, Git blob `fda2a852e9937e42fe40df0707694465ca7c1b48`.

The standalone proof cancels28H4, leaving equal residual rank masses5263 with target ranks 7/8/9 above 6 and paid ranks 1..5 below 6. Exact rational logarithm/Taylor bounds give paid-minus-target deficit greater than `13559903132446535673/500000000000000000 >27` at the named C. This written economic support is outside the registered component replay; no fractional powers, new price point or Powers engine ran.

It does not execute the producer, original T checker, native/phase engine, economic certificate, compiler or complete caller. ## Open next questions

The useful next economic object is an actual global occurrence/owner ledger: prove each response reuse has the same chronological input, physical map, chart, phase, axes and lifetime; debit displaced helpers once; then test the complete changed paid/target profile. The fixed standalone H1-only profile cannot pass with at most 27 additional deletions at the target C. A different caller needs its own bound.

A complete physical raw dual, canonical independent outputs, ordinary/precision/stock/tape/geometry application, compiler reserve and separate outer transfer remain open. Main functional inversion does not prove helper inversion. κ>=.0033 remains an unfunded research goal; selected metadata is unchanged. The peer's separately owned changed caller work continues.
